name: Mirage F-1CZ, South African Air Force low viz pack
summary: South African Air Force low-visibility F-1CZ liveries for the Aerges Mirage F1, in two download parts.
description: SAAF low-viz livery pack for the Mirage F1 (F1CE folder). Copy the extracted files into `Saved Games\DCS\Liveries\Mirage-F1CE` (the author also gives a CoreMods path as an option). Part 2 (https://files.digitalcombatsimulator.com/en/files/3329502/, 95.3 MB) must be installed together with Part 1.
